## Checklist

- [ ] Docs updated in `docs/wiki/` (published to the wiki) and the README if the options changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or private log content in the diff or screenshots
- [ ] Reviewed the security impact: this adds no unauthenticated way to read logs, run commands or load external content
